RESEARCH OPPORTUNITY

Ph.D. researcher

Conduct field and laboratory research in soil and water biogeochemistry across natural and engineered soil and aquatic systems.

All opportunitiesFULLY FUNDED · FALL 2027

Your research

  • Field sampling and laboratory analysis of soil, water, and gas samples.
  • Data management, statistical analysis, and reproducible analytical workflows.
  • Peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations.

Required qualifications

  • A master’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, Soil Science, Water Science, Biology, Chemistry, or a closely related discipline, completed by enrollment.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • A professional, collaborative working style.

Preferred qualifications

  • Research experience with soils, wetlands, cropping systems, or stormwater treatment systems.
  • Demonstrated analytical laboratory skills.
  • Training or experience in statistics; proficiency in R or Python.
  • A valid driver’s license and ability to drive for fieldwork.

Funding

  • Full funding is available for competitive applicants through a combination of fellowship and graduate assistantship support.

HOW TO APPLY

Let’s hear from you.

Email Dr. Jing Hu with the subject line PhD27 and include:

  • Curriculum vitae (CV).
  • Statement of research interests (1–2 pages).
  • Unofficial transcripts.
  • Contact information for two to three references.
Email your applicationjing.hu@ucf.edu
